Reranking with top_n parameter to limit results

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.rerank_async(LiterLlm::RerankRequest.new(documents: ['Python is a programming language.', 'Cats are cute animals.', 'Python was created by Guido van Rossum.', 'The sun is a star.'], model: 'rerank-v3.5', query: 'What is Python?', top_n: 2))
puts result.results.inspect
puts result.results[0].relevance_score.inspect
```
